name: How long does a standard kitchen sink installation take?

mainEntity.name: How long does a standard kitchen sink installation take?

acceptedAnswer.text: A standard kitchen sink installation typically takes 3 to 6 hours, assuming no unexpected plumbing issues or significant countertop modifications. If existing plumbing needs extensive rerouting, or if a new sink requires custom cuts to a stone countertop, the process can take longer. It's best to discuss specific timelines during your project consultation.
acceptedAnswer.description: Standard kitchen sink installation usually takes 3-6 hours. Complex plumbing or custom countertop work can extend this timeframe.
